The air crackled with the sheer voltage of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, snapping around his boots like impatient hounds. He didn't hesitate to CONSUME the raw arc-flash data through the baton's interface, ignoring the stinging warmth of the copper grip as he read the live kinetics. Ahead, a heavy magnetic funnel threatened to rip his tools away, but he managed to DEFEND his utility belt with a swift pivot, laughing loudly over the storm's roar. With a daring leap over a sparking capacitor bank, he tossed a decoy wrench to ATTRACT a stray discharge, clearing his path to Kaio. The wind howled as he landed gracefully, shoving the glowing baton firmly into Kaio's hands without missing a beat.
